user.title: Add DHL Packstation
user.description: Shows available locker compartments by size (S, M, L, XL) and total. Updates every 15 minutes. Enter the station's five-digit postal code and three-digit Packstation number. Add the integration again for more stations. Leading zeros in postal codes are supported.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read live compartment data. Check the postal code and Packstation number.
error.wrong_station: DHL returned a different postal code or Packstation number.
